_about: Extra choices on the Create page's Advanced tab. Each choice adds words to the prompt and to what the model avoids; the first value of each is the default and adds nothing. They cost no extra time. Change the words here; the page reads this file each time.

values.label: Detailed
values.prompt: detailed face, detailed eyes, detailed hair, detailed clothes, intricate details
values.negative: lack of detail, multiple views, expression chart, character sheet

values.label: Fewer
values.prompt: smooth face, clean face, soft facial features
values.negative: wrinkles, face lines, facial lines, nasolabial folds, eye bags, creases

values.label: More
values.prompt: expressive face lines, defined facial features

values.label: From the front
values.prompt: front lighting, evenly lit, bright face, full color
values.negative: silhouette, backlighting, dark, shadow on face, rim light, dramatic lighting

values.label: Dramatic
values.prompt: dramatic lighting, strong shadows, rim light

values.label: Bold
values.prompt: thick outlines, full color, vibrant colors
values.negative: thin lines, lineart only, uncolored, silhouette
